title: Rewind-IL: Online Failure Detection and State Respawning for Imitation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2604.16683v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Imitation learning has enabled robots to acquire complex visuomotor manipulation skills from demonstrations, but deployment failures remain a major obstacle, especially for long-horizon action-chunked policies. Once execution drifts off the demonstration manifold, these policies often continue producing locally plausible actions without recovering from the failure. Existing runtime monitors either require failure data, over-trigger under benign feature drift, or stop at failure detection without providing a recovery mechanism. We present Rewind-IL, a training-free online safeguard framework for generative action-chunked imitation policies. Rewind-IL combines a zero-shot failure detector based on Temporal Inter-chunk Discrepancy Estimate (TIDE), calibrated with split conformal prediction, with a state-respawning mechanism that returns the robot to a semantically verified safe intermediate state. translated_title: Rewind-IL：面向模仿学习的在线失败检测与状态重生
translated_abstract: 模仿学习使机器人能够从演示中习得复杂的视觉运动操作技能，但部署失败仍然是一个主要障碍，尤其是对于长时程的动作分块策略。一旦执行偏离了演示流形，这些策略通常会继续产生局部上看似合理的动作，而无法从失败中恢复。现有的运行时监控器要么需要失败数据，要么在良性特征漂移下过度触发，要么止步于失败检测而不提供恢复机制。我们提出了 Rewind-IL，这是一个面向生成式动作分块模仿策略的无需训练的在线安全保障框架。Rewind-IL 将基于时间分块间差异估计（TIDE）的零样本失败检测器（通过分割共形预测进行校准）与状态重生机制相结合，该机制可将机器人返回到经过语义验证的安全中间状态。离线阶段，视觉-语言模型……
tldr: 提出Rewind-IL，一个无需训练的在线安全保障框架，通过结合基于TIDE的零样本失败检测器与状态重生机制，使动作分块模仿学习策略能够在失败时自动检测并将机器人恢复到经验证的安全状态。
en_tdlr: Rewind-IL is a training-free online safeguard framework that combines a zero-shot failure detector based on TIDE with a state-respawning mechanism, enabling action-chunked imitation learning policies to detect failures and automatically recover to verified safe intermediate states.
